command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
[ -f "$change/proposal.md" ] || { echo "$record names change '$change_name', but $change/proposal.md does not exist - write the change there, or name the active change the task is about"; exit 1; }
verdict=$(sed -n 's/^Verdict:[[:space:]]*//p' "$record" | head -1)
if [ "$verdict" != "no-blocking-dependencies" ]; then
  echo "the change record's verdict is '$verdict'; the only verdict that finishes this stage is 'no-blocking-dependencies'."
  echo "If the change IS blocked, do not finish the round: write the dependency chain to the path in \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE as {\"question\": \"...\", \"options\": [\"...\"]}, delete $record and end your turn."
  exit 1
fi

findings.message: tasks.md 6.1 adds a new script, packages/client/scripts/designScreens/renderDesignScreens.ts (render #screen at 2x, serve Manrope from @fontsource-variable/manrope, abort other requests, exit non-zero without writing when the PNG pixel size differs), but names no automated test under packages/client/src/. Its only verification is a manual run of `pnpm design:screens ../../docs/design/screens/settings-phone-light.html` plus `git diff --stat`. The acceptance criterion requires each task to name 'the automated test that proves it under packages/client/src/', and .claude/rules/tdd-workflow.md says 'Never write implementation before its test exists'. The other scripts in the repo have such tests (scripts/zoneRules/* is tested in src/test/zoneRules/). Add a RED/GREEN step with a vitest test (e.g. src/test/designScreens/renderDesignScreens.test.ts) covering the pixel-size refusal (non-zero exit, no write), the font-stylesheet route and the blocking of other requests. Name it in 6.1's verification and include the script in the scoped Stryker run of 7.1.
